name: Sodom

identification.note: Likely located near the Dead Sea, possibly beneath its southern basin, but no site is confidently confirmed.

related_people.name: Bera
related_people.role: king of this city, defeated in the war of the four kings and met by Abram afterward

related_people.name: Lot
related_people.role: chose to settle in this city, and was dragged out by angels the night it was destroyed

description: A city of the plain notorious for wickedness, destroyed by fire and sulfur from heaven after Abraham's intercession failed to find even ten righteous people there; Lot and his daughters escaped, though his wife looked back and was turned to a pillar of salt (Genesis 18:16-19:29).
